content:
Numina Fuse is here :rocket:

Today we're opening Numina Fuse to its first wave of testers.

Fuse is an autoformalization workspace that fuses informal and formal mathematics into one workflow. Point it at a source, whether a paper, a chapter, or your own notes, and Fuse drafts a lightweight blueprint with the Lean code sitting right beside it.

A coding agent handles the heavy lifting:

  • Writes Lean and iterates against the compiler
  • Builds your project and chases down errors
  • Searches Mathlib for the right lemmas
  • Grinds through proofs on its own

It all runs in the cloud, so you can turn on auto mode and throw it a hard problem, close your laptop, and come back to finished work.

Fuse is in early access and we're hand-selecting testers from applications. Your data stays private and is never used to train models.

Apply now at fuse.projectnumina.ai, and see the Numina blog post for more details.

Special thanks to @Ruichen Qiu, @Yichuan Cao, @Hugues de Saxcé, and @Junqi Liu for their contributions.
